nextItem.title: MC Works 2023 Explosion 817HF Special Model
nextItem.excerpt:
The MC WORKS Explosion series incorporates a medium elastic multi-ply structure enable a rod which is light, responsive and has a powerful backbone. Ideal for casting stickbaits and diving pencils, this series is designed for kingfish and tuna anglers.

With a higher PE rating and wide casting range, the 817HF is the perfect model for anglers seeking a powerful rod to handle monstrous kingfish and GT’s. The blank enables a comfortable yet powerful fight with an ease of manoeuvrability. The rod will swim lures accurately in addition to superior casting and control.

Handmade in Japan

Length: 8'1 ”

Line: PE # 6-10

Cast: 100-200G

Drag max: 18KG

Guide: Titanium Hybrid PMNSG + KWSG guide

Code: #2304EXP817HFSP

Colourway: Black x titanium pin stripes & pewter wrapping (butt section) & gunmetal
